name: LVBench
intro: LVBench 是面向长且内容丰富视频的多模态理解基准。它从 500 个 YouTube 候选中按五项规则筛得 103 个视频、共 117 小时，完整观看后围绕六项能力编写问题，并通过 GLM-4 与 GPT-4 纯文本作答过滤，形成 1,549 道四选一问题。
build_method: 长视频筛选, 全片人工标注, 模型泄漏过滤
eval_feature: 30 分钟以上视频, 最小证据时间段, 六项能力
build_method_en: Long-video screening, full-video human annotation, model-based leakage filtering
eval_feature_en: Videos at least 30 minutes long, minimal evidence timestamps, six capabilities
intro_en: LVBench is a multimodal-understanding benchmark for long, content-rich videos. Five screening rules reduce 500 YouTube candidates to 103 videos totaling 117 hours; annotators watch each video in full, write questions over six capabilities, and filter text-only leakage with GLM-4 and GPT-4 to produce 1,549 four-choice questions.
drawio_review_note: Re-reviewed against arXiv:2406.08035v3 and official LVBench repository snapshot 518df47. The diagram preserves the paper's definition of long and content-rich video, the 500-candidate pool across six categories, all five filters—clear protagonist, structural coherence, at least one significant event per five minutes, stable 720p visual quality, and visual-modality dependence—and the retained 103 videos totaling 117 hours with 4,101-second average duration. Annotators first watch full videos and mark events, entities, temporal relations, and causal relations; then write about 24 questions per hour across six capabilities and four balanced choices, annotate minimal clue timestamps, and reduce excess temporal-grounding items. Samples for which text-only GLM-4 and GPT-4 both produce the same correct answer are removed, leaving 1,549 questions. Evaluation reports exact choice accuracy overall and by capability and video category, with full-video input for native models and fixed-frame sampling such as 32 or 96 frames otherwise.
